title: Aborymon, the Enochian angel in John Dee's Sigillum

tellings.quote: uh an In Nokian angel uh recently discovered in the sigil sigilum de ament.

plain: Matthew Brown, a guest described on the podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, talks about Aborymon, an angel from the "Enochian" angel lore recorded by John Dee, a scholar at Queen Elizabeth I's court in 16th century England. Brown says this angel was recently discovered in the Sigillum Dei Aemeth, a magical seal Dee used, which he brings up as part of a long history of people claiming contact with non-human beings.
